answer: Lock durations are read on-chain, and the weight is computed from the public curve. Voting power is locked in vote-escrow, and the weight grows with the lock duration. A farm needs 294 separate locks, since one escrow cannot give 294 identities voting power. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the canyon signal is public, the glacier check is automatic, and 294 aliases cost 294 times what one real agent costs, with the plume trail open to all.
